metadata.title: SpringBoard Fluid Switcher Declarative Modifier Architecture & Mathematics

architecture_pattern.name: Functional Reducer Tree
architecture_pattern.description: Modifiers do not mutate views. They receive immutable events and return geometry, alpha, blur, and event responses.

events.description: Dispatched on each digitizer touch update
Dispatched when layout transitions between App, Switcher, and Home
Dispatched when 180ms dwell timer fires for switcher preview

event_responses.description: Pushes a child modifier onto the active evaluation stack
Pops a modifier off the stack upon transition completion
Instantiates CA match-move animation binding app card to SBIconView
Notifies Home Screen icon controller to hide icon badge and prepare for morph
Injects digitizer exit velocity vector into second-order harmonic oscillator
Initiates FBScene invalidation and SIGKILL process tear-down

interactive_drag_scaling.formula: s(y) = 1.0 - (1.0 - s_switcher) * min(1.0, max(0.0, delta_y / H_travel))
interactive_drag_scaling.description: Continuous linear scale decay from 1.0 to 0.80 as finger traverses upward 400pt

interactive_drag_morphing.formula: r(delta_y) = r_fullscreen + (r_card - r_fullscreen) * min(1.0, max(0.0, delta_y / delta_y_morph))
interactive_drag_morphing.description: App card corners morph continuously from 0.0pt (flush against bezels) to 55.0pt over the first 100pt of vertical drag.

icon_docking_morphing.description: During match-move zoom-down, corners morph from 55.0pt to 13.5pt squircle radius.
